fritzbox_help: State of the FRITZ!Box: internet connection, data rates, external IP, Wi-Fi, messages and missed calls. A click opens the mesh topology.
mesh_help: Mesh topology of the FRITZ!Box: mesh master, repeaters and the connected devices
presence_help: The devices of the tab "Devices" or the persons of the tab "Persons" of the instance: present or away
name: Name
title: Title
hide_details_tooltip: Only name, online state and data rate, whatever the size
switch_wlan_tooltip: A click on Wi-Fi or Guest switches it on or off
show_messages_tooltip: New messages on the answering machine, missed calls and an incoming call - only if the states exist
no_mesh_tooltip: A click on the tile does not open the mesh topology
interval_tooltip: The topology is read only while the widget is visible. At least 10 seconds
view_tooltip: Default of the view. What the viewer changes is remembered in the browser until this setting is changed
ab_messages: New messages on the answering machine
reset_missed_text: The counter is set to 0. It is the counter of the adapter (currently %s), not a value of the FRITZ!Box: it counts every missed call since the installation. The call lists themselves stay unchanged.
no_devices: No devices. Add them in the tab "Devices" of the instance.
person_help: One person of the presence detection (tab "Persons" of the instance): present or away, since when, and the last comings and goings
person_tooltip: Name of the person as in the tab "Persons" of the instance
image_tooltip: E.g. a photo of the person. Used for both states if a state has neither an own image nor an own icon
show_history_tooltip: Only if the widget is high enough. From a history instance if it logs the state "present" of the person, otherwise the list of the adapter
history_days_tooltip: How many days are read from a history instance
show_export_tooltip: Button in the history which downloads the comings and goings of the set days as a CSV file for Excel
select_person: Select a person in the settings of the widget
mode_tooltip: The devices of the tab "Devices" or the persons of the tab "Persons"
show_guests_tooltip: The number of active devices in the guest network, if the instance counts them
no_persons: No persons. Add them in the tab "Persons" of the instance.
guest_qr_help: QR code of the guest Wi-Fi: a phone joins by scanning it with the camera. Shown on the widget, or in a dialog after a click - optionally only after a PIN.
guest_mode_dialog: In a dialog after a click
guest_mode_pin: In a dialog after the PIN
guest_pin_tooltip: Asked before the code is shown. It is stored in the vis project: it keeps guests away from the code, it is no protection against somebody who can edit the project
guest_auto_close_tooltip: The code does not stay on the screen. 0 = never
